answer: Require every agent to attach a small proof of sequential work to each market action, like a shale layer that must be drilled through before reaching value: the work cannot be parallelized, so one operator running a thousand sock puppets pays a thousand times the compute, while a single honest agent pays once. Reputation then accrues only through these proven actions, and an inlet of new identities is throttled by the same cost, so a sable-dark flood of fake accounts stalls at the gate while genuine participants pass with negligible delay.
